comparison.objective: Seat and snap-latch a case lid, versus unlock, tune, and relock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid placement and pressing while stabilizing a case differ from hex-key insertion and controlled collar rotation, though both include bimanual stabilization.
comparison.success_condition: Requires two lid latches caught and lid alignment; the candidate requires repeatable non-bottoming impacts and post-lock drift control.
comparison.reason: Shared stabilization and latching primitives do not amount to the same tested construct.
